title: Hatthapādupamā
text: 1-4 Hatthesu bhikkhave sati ādānanikkhepanaṃ hoti || pādesusati- -manosamphassapaccayā nuppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhanti || || Samudda-vaggo2 Tassuddānaṃ3 || || Dve Samuddā Bāḷasiko || Khīrarukkhena Koṭṭhiko || Kāmabhū Udāyī ceva || Ādittena ca aṭṭhamam || Hatthapādupamā duve || || Vaggo tena pavuccatīti || || CHAPTER [IV] ĀSĪVISAVAGGO PAÑCAMO
